name: W Seattle
positioning: A downtown Seattle W hotel steps from Pike Place Market, with a floor of artist-painted guest rooms, a recording studio suite and a Whatever/Whenever concierge
best_for: City-break travelers who want to walk to Pike Place Market and the waterfront
Music and art fans drawn to the mural rooms and the Sound Suite recording studio

facts.text: The Seattle Waterfront is a short walk from the hotel.
Each 14th-floor mural is a unique portrait representing one of Seattle's neighborhoods.
Rooms draw inspiration from the Pacific Northwest and feature city views, Davines bath amenities and a W signature pillowtop bed.
The Penthouse suite is 24 floors up, with a master bedroom, walk-in closet and living and dining space.
The Living Room bar has live DJs and bands on weekends and handcrafted cocktails daily.
TRACE Market serves Pacific Northwest food for dine-in, take-out or grab-and-go.
Aescape robotic massage is available on site.
The FIT gym has Life Fitness cardio and strength equipment.
Up to two pets of any size are welcome per room.

highlights.text: Every guest room on the 14th floor has an original hand-painted mural by resident artist Morgan Zion.
The W Sound Suite is a full recording studio with views of Mt. Rainier.
The Whatever/Whenever service can arrange things like Seattle Opera seats, a personal shopper at the Nordstrom flagship or a seaplane ride over Lake Union.
The hotel is in the heart of downtown Seattle, steps from attractions such as Pike Place Market.

considerations.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
WhataHotel notes the busy downtown location may bring some city noise.
